meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动操控浏览器：打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截取屏幕、提取文字和数据等。
howto.when: 当用户要求搜索信息、访问网站、提取网页内容或填写表单时，Claude 会主动使用浏览器来完成。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的天气
say.note: Claude 会打开天气网站并返回结果。
Claude 会访问百度并保存截图。

say.text: 提取这个页面的所有链接
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并列出链接。

howto.what_en: Claude gains the ability to control a browser: open web pages, click links, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text and data, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to search, visit a website, extract web content, or fill a form. Claude will also use the browser proactively when it deems a browser useful.

say_en.note: Claude will open a weather site and return the result.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Claude will visit Baidu and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Extract all links from this page
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the page and list the links.
